Acme.description: Example vendor signals (docs/DEPLOY.md, ADR-0052): driver monitoring and an HMI warning level.

DrowsinessLevel.description: Drowsiness estimate: 0 = alert, 1 = slight, 2 = drowsy, 3 = asleep.

Hmi.description: Cluster warnings of the example vendor.

WarningLevel.description: Warning shown on the cluster: 0 = none, 1 = info, 2 = warning, 3 = critical.
